reviewer.tool: captured PNG evidence, Debug terminal/residency readback and local image inspection; local Symphony vision disabled

imagesInspected.observation: Acceptance-run microscope: fully textured, complete/Ready, no failure overlay.
Acceptance-run Camera: dark lens with reflection/depth, body and strap readable, no terminal error.
Acceptance-run Car: complete red body and interior; known windshield/side-glass speckle/order remains T26/T27.
Acceptance-run reused-image fixture: one sphere from the reused color map and distinct data map; exactly two resident textures.
One sphere shaded by the reused 128px color map and the distinct data map; the model reports exactly two resident textures and reaches complete/Ready with no terminal error.
Fully textured microscope (brass, enamel, glass), complete/Ready, no failure overlay. Textures are 3 x 2048px with 12 mips; GPU 112,263,168 bytes against a 1,023,410,176-byte detail target.
Camera keeps its dark lens with visible reflection/depth and its strap/body separation; complete load, no terminal error.
Car renders complete with the known windshield/side-glass speckle and ordering owned by T26/T27; no late ResourceLimit and no missing textures.

observations: The microscope's former failure is measured, not inferred: Debug import/capture reported ImportStage::GenerationDeadline (17) and ImportErrorCode::ResourceLimit (2) at ~301 s while the model was already visible. Its 2048px/12-mip texture set used 134,742,016 GPU bytes against a ~976 MiB detail target, so no texture byte/pixel, mip-chain, catalog or GPU-residency cap was the limiter.

The limiter was the broker's absolute 300 s generation wall-clock deadline applied to the background detail replay: the replay loop waited for a visible-detail request forever after the viewer had stopped asking. The broker now ends an idle replay cleanly with EndDetail (bounded initial grace, bounded post-request idle grace and a bounded request count); the worker returns to the pool and the generation completes instead of failing after the model is fully usable.

The microscope's duplicate diffuse map (two glTF image entries naming the same sidecar) now decodes and uploads once per semantic/color space: resident model textures fall from 4 to 3 and the complete set uses 112,263,168 bytes.

Capture readiness now requires terminal complete/degraded import, the expected generation, geometry residency, no pending detail request, settled pixels and quiet texture counters. A terminal error discovered before or after the first visible geometry raises instead of producing a qualified capture.
The hostile/oversized/decompression/cancellation/texture boundary lanes remain green; the reused-image fixture and the shortened-deadline idle-replay case are the new T23 regressions.

defects.label: known-defect
defects.description: Car windshield/side-glass speckle and interpenetration ordering remain T26/T27 work; T23 only establishes a complete, settled, error-free load.

positives: The microscope opens safely and reaches a truthfully complete state; the late ResourceLimit is not reproduced in the Debug lane.
The reused-image accounting is measured end-to-end (resident texture count, extent, mips and GPU bytes), not inferred from the overlay or compressed file size.
An idle detail replay ends as a successful/degraded completion with a typed, bounded lifecycle signal; an outstanding detail reply still fails at the deadline.
Camera and Car remain complete and error-free after the change.
